spec.name: aq_PT08_S2_NMHC
spec.doc: Fourier approximation of the Air Quality series PT08.S2(NMHC) (cleaned; i = hours since 2004-03-10 18:00): intercept, 5 largest FFT components and Gaussian noise with the residual SD.
spec.expression: a0 + a1 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f1 * i + p1) + a2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f2 * i + p2) + a3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f3 * i + p3) + a4 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f4 * i + p4) + a5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * f5 * i + p5) + np.random.normal(0, s)
